law: Tool-first recursive self-improvement: no critical agent work before its own failure classes and recovery are proven. Failure memory must serve next session in one lookup; UNKNOWN never authorizes a protected effect.

modes.diagnosis: Both Gemini and MiniMax-M2.7 returned HTTP 429; provider capacity exhausted.
modes.recovery: Preserve issue plus encrypted partial patches. Pause both provider lanes; use existing approved capacity probe before one scoped fresh dispatch. After two identical failures change provider or owner, not retry again.
modes.proof: Real provider response, trusted firewall pass, exact governed lane and deployed effect receipt.

modes.diagnosis: Primary model was rate-limited; fallback availability must be measured.
modes.recovery: Reuse a proven already-authorized fallback once if its capacity receipt is fresh; otherwise preserve mission and defer until verified capacity.
modes.proof: Authenticated fallback response and successfully applied mission.

modes.diagnosis: Authentication denied; job-local empty secret does not establish unavailable broker credentials.
modes.recovery: Verify an authorized nonsecret broker-resolution receipt and route custody correction through existing owner. No speculative key rotation.
modes.proof: Broker resolution readback plus scoped successful model response.

modes.diagnosis: Runner, network, TLS or upstream transport interrupted request.
modes.recovery: Distinguish assigned runner, DNS/TLS and upstream status with existing probes; use an approved alternate executor only with authenticated evidence.
modes.proof: Real runner ID and executed steps followed by independent service effect.

modes.recovery: Use canonical approved capability map and select a tested available model, not a guessed alias.
modes.proof: Model availability and real successful task result.

modes.diagnosis: Harness returned no durable transcript or failed before initialization.
modes.recovery: Preserve original issue and any encrypted stdout or patch; use existing no-secret harness startup fixture, then retry the same mission with authorized runner.
modes.proof: New actual transcript sealed and trusted firewall executed.

modes.diagnosis: Epistemic firewall detected false claims or was BLIND.
modes.recovery: Quarantine ungraded patch, preserve encrypted transcript and route independent bounded repair using the same mission issue.
modes.proof: Independent corrected transcript passes original firewall; forged negative control still denied.

modes.diagnosis: Claim, hook, patch, App token or Greenlane submission failed after model work.
modes.recovery: Reuse original sealed patch and claim, determine exact failing native gate, repair that path without rerunning the model.
modes.proof: Existing Greenlane lands exact SHA and independent runtime effect is recorded.

modes.diagnosis: Workflow queued but no runner ID or executed steps.
modes.recovery: Verify actual runner assignment against trusted GitHub run. Restore permitted host or use existing approved cloud executor.
modes.proof: Runner ID > 0, actual steps, no orphaned work, receipt on original issue.

modes.diagnosis: Opened and labeled events started duplicate model runs for one issue.
modes.recovery: Deduplicate by canonical mission fingerprint before model invocation; retain one primary execution and preserve original issue evidence.
modes.proof: One run accepted per mission fingerprint and no concurrent duplicate provider calls.

modes.diagnosis: No registered failure fingerprint or insufficient evidence to classify.
modes.recovery: Quarantine protected effects, preserve mission and sealed evidence; add a tested failure class, safe probe and bounded recovery before another attempt.
modes.proof: New failure class plus falsifying test and independent verified recovery effect.
